title: Admin copy tells the admin to call the REST API (SMS Send test: pass "to" in the request body; the flow clone notice: PUT /api/v1/automation/<name>) — keep endpoints out of admin copy (hotcrm#2194 R2-T2-U07)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 管理员界面的文案让管理员去调 REST 接口：短信「发送测试」说「在请求体里传 to」，克隆自动化后的提示说「把完整定义 PUT 到 /api/v1/automation/<name>」。
- **要做：** 管理员文案里不出现接口路径。克隆提示这一半原定并入 objectstack-ai/objectui#13270，但那张卡已关闭且保留了服务端原文，文案在本仓 runtime，一并在本卡处理。
- **完成标准：** 两处文案不再含接口或请求体说明。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T2-U07** (the SMS half; the clone-notice half was folded into objectstack-ai/objectui#13270, which closed `completed` before the ruling with the notice kept verbatim, and the notice text is this repo's, so it rides here too: see *Why*). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Pages / persona:** Setup → SMS Delivery (Send test) and Setup → Packaged Automation (Clone), the system administrator.
- **Now (18.0.0):** "otherwise pass "to" in the request body", and "send its complete definition with `status: 'obsolete'` to `PUT /api/v1/automation/<name>`. The activation toggle (`POST /api/v1/automation/<name>/toggle`) switches packaged flows only and refuses the clone."
- **Cost:** two new instances of developer copy since the round 1 pass (T2-U02 / T2-U07).
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-07; [`23-config-settings-sms.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/23-config-settings-sms.png), [`03-F01-packaged-automation-clone-runs-beside-original.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/03-F01-packaged-automation-clone-runs-beside-original.png).
- **The clone half's carrier:** objectstack-ai/objectui#13270 landed (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13279, closed 2026-10-20T18:56Z) a **Switch "…" off** action beside the notice and kept the server's notice verbatim, so the REST sentence still shows.

## Landing

Read on objectstack `origin/main` `7b047b44`:
- `packages/services/service-sms/src/sms-plugin.ts` ~:102, ~:115, ~:124: "Pass \"to\" in the request body …" in the Send test answers.
- `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts` ~:183–185: the clone notice's REST recipe. `packages/client/src/index.ts` ~:5698 documents the same for SDK callers, which stays (it is developer copy).
- Where the admin needs a control instead of the recipe, it exists: the console's Switch off (objectstack-ai/objectui#13270) for the clone, and #24767's recipient field for the SMS test.

## Done when

- The SMS Send test answers and the clone notice served to the console contain no endpoint path and no request-body instruction; each names the control the admin uses instead.
- The REST detail stays where developers read it (the client TSDoc, the API docs).
- Pins on both strings.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `sms`, `clone`, `request body`, `admin copy`. 4 hits, all closed: #24983, #24924 (notification-template channels), #24767 (the SMS recipient field) and #24359 (unrelated). Not on point. **New.**
